# Resources

**← Back to [EAP Home](../README.md)**

---

> This section provides essential resources, templates, learning materials, and career development tools to support the Enterprise Architecture community. These resources enable architects and teams to effectively execute architectural work, develop their skills, and advance their careers while maintaining consistency and quality across the EA practice.

## 1.0 Resources Overview

The Resources section consolidates practical tools, templates, and learning materials that support day-to-day architectural work and professional development. This section serves as a centralized hub for:
page_texts.4:
[resources/README.md#key-characteristics]

### Key Characteristics

- **Practical Application**: Ready-to-use templates, guides, and frameworks
- **Career Development**: Learning paths, training materials, and role definitions
- **Standardization**: Consistent approaches across the EA practice
- **Continuous Learning**: Onboarding and ongoing skill development resources
- **Quality Enablement**: Tools and templates that ensure consistent delivery
page_texts.5:
[resources/README.md#target-audience]

### Target Audience

- **New Team Members**: Onboarding materials and getting started guides
- **Enterprise Architects**: Templates, work artifacts, and professional development resources
- **Solution Architects**: Practical templates and assessment frameworks
- **Development Teams**: Standards templates and governance artifacts
- **Hiring Managers**: Role definitions and job descriptions
- **EA Leadership**: Program management and governance tools

---
page_texts.7:
[resources/README.md#-work-templateswork-templatesreadmemd]

### 📝 [Work Templates](./work-templates/README.md)

Standardized templates and checklists for EA governance gates, architecture artifacts, assessments, service design packages, and workshops. Templates ensure consistency, efficiency, and quality across all EA processes.

**Key Resources:**

- Architecture artifact templates (white papers, standards, patterns, ADRs)
- EA maturity and compliance assessment frameworks
- Governance gate templates and review checklists
- Service design package documentation
- Workshop facilitation frameworks and agendas
page_texts.8:
[resources/README.md#-training--developmenttrainingreadmemd]

### 🎓 [Training & Development](./training/README.md)

Comprehensive training and development framework defining competency areas, skill development pathways, learning programs, and career progression paths for building architectural capabilities across the organization.

**Key Resources:**

- Architecture competency framework and skill matrices
- Role-based learning pathways (foundational, intermediate, advanced)
- External training and certification programs
- Mentorship and peer learning programs
- Medicaid healthcare-specific architecture training
page_texts.9:
[resources/README.md#-onboardingonboardingreadmemd]

### 🚀 [Onboarding](./onboarding/README.md)

Structured onboarding materials and resources to help new team members quickly become productive members of the Enterprise Architecture community, with role-specific learning paths and essential setup guides.

**Key Resources:**

- First week onboarding checklist and activities
- GitHub account and environment setup guides
- Role-based learning paths for different architecture positions
- Essential EA practice resources and quick reference guides
- Mentorship program and community integration support
page_texts.10:
[resources/README.md#-job-descriptionsjob-descriptionsreadmemd]

### 💼 [Job Descriptions](./job-descriptions/README.md)

Standardized job descriptions and role definitions for all positions within the Enterprise Architecture Practice, ensuring consistent hiring practices, clear role expectations, and aligned career development paths.

**Key Resources:**

- Enterprise architect roles (Associate through Lead levels)
- Specialized architect positions (Application, Business, Cloud, Data, Security, Solution)
- Supporting roles (Analyst, Program Manager, Technical Writer)
- Architecture career ladder and progression framework
- Role comparison matrices and competency requirements

---
page_texts.12:
[resources/README.md#for-new-team-members]

### For New Team Members

Start with [Onboarding](./onboarding/README.md) to access structured learning paths, setup guides, and essential resources for your first weeks on the team.

**Quick Path:**

1. Complete onboarding checklist
2. Review your [role-specific job description](./job-descriptions/README.md)
3. Explore [training pathways](./training/README.md) for your career level
4. Familiarize yourself with [work templates](./work-templates/README.md) you'll use
page_texts.13:
[resources/README.md#for-architects-creating-deliverables]

### For Architects Creating Deliverables

Access [Work Templates](./work-templates/README.md) for standardized templates across all EA activities including artifacts, assessments, governance, and workshops.

**Quick Path:**

1. Identify your deliverable type (artifact, assessment, governance, etc.)
2. Download the appropriate template
3. Follow template completion guidelines
4. Submit according to governance process
page_texts.14:
[resources/README.md#for-managers-and-leaders]

### For Managers and Leaders

Review [Job Descriptions](./job-descriptions/README.md) for hiring and [Training](./training/README.md) for team development and capability building.

**Quick Path:**

1. Use job descriptions for hiring and role clarity
2. Review competency frameworks for team assessment
3. Create individual development plans using training pathways
4. Leverage mentorship programs for team growth
page_texts.15:
[resources/README.md#for-career-development]

### For Career Development

Explore [Training & Development](./training/README.md) for competency frameworks, learning programs, and career progression paths aligned with your role and aspirations.

**Quick Path:**

1. Review competency framework for your role level
2. Complete skills assessment
3. Create personalized learning plan
4. Engage with mentorship and peer learning
